Roman inclusive counting means the reference day counts as day 1.

1. ante diem III Kalendas Martias = 3 days before Mar 1 counting inclusively = Feb 27 → 27.02  
2. pridie Idus Octobres = day before Oct 15 = Oct 14 → 14.10  
3. ante diem VI Nonas Maias = 6 days before May 7 counting inclusively = May 2 → 02.05  
4. ante diem XVII Kalendas Ianuarias = 17 days before Jan 1 counting inclusively = Dec 16 → 16.12  
5. ante diem VIII Idus Iulias = 8 days before Jul 15 counting inclusively = Jul 8 → 08.07  
6. ante diem XI Kalendas Iunias = 11 days before Jun 1 counting inclusively = May 22 → 22.05  

ANSWER: 27.02, 14.10, 02.05, 16.12, 08.07, 22.05
